name: Browser Act
description: Do one thing in this chat's browser tab and read the page after: click, fill (replace a field's text), type (key by key, for fields that react as you type), press (one key like Enter, Escape, Tab, Backspace, an arrow or a character, or Shift with Tab or an arrow, on ref or the page; no Control, Meta or Alt shortcuts), select (an option of a dropdown, by its label), check/uncheck, hover, scroll_down/scroll_up (the page, or to ref), back, forward, reload, or wait (text = seconds, up to 10). ref is an element's ref from the last read, like e12. Never type a password, card number or one-time code: log in with browser-login, or hand the browser to the user with browser-handoff. Before anything that sends, buys, posts, deletes or can't be undone, ask the user in your reply first.
author: anything

ref.description: The element's ref from the last read (e12); none for press on the page, scrolling the page, back, forward, reload and wait.

text.description: The text for fill and type, the key for press, the option for select, the seconds for wait.
